elements.name: Retain an individual large button when ribbon text is turned off

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open with the full 3D Model ribbon in Normal appearance
Shell is displayed at Standard button size in the Modify panel
the user changes the Shell button size to Large
Shell appears as a large labeled button
the user selects Text Off from Ribbon Appearance
command labels are hidden and the Modify panel title remains visible
Shell appears as a large icon without its label
the user opens the Shell button size submenu
the user selects Standard for Shell
the user restores Normal ribbon appearance
Shell returns to its standard labeled presentation

elements.name: Retain an individual large button when ribbon text is turned off

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory
